name: Nine1F Social Media
summary: Viral short-form social video platform in GTA VI parodying TikTok and Instagram Reels. Plays a central role in environmental storytelling and viral world-building.
description: Nine1F is a defining innovation of GTA VI's modern setting. Seen heavily throughout Trailer 1, vertical video feeds with real-time comments, livestreams, and viral clips capture outrageous Florida-style events: twerking on car roofs, alligator captures in neighborhood pools, high-speed police pursuits, and street fights. Players access Nine1F feeds through their in-game smartphone.
slogan: Live Your Best Life. Stream Everything.

seo.title: Nine1F Social App: GTA VI Viral Smartphone System
seo.description: Examine the Nine1F social media platform in GTA VI. Vertical video feeds, livestream mechanics, in-game smartphone features, and trailer breakdowns.
